## Checklist

- [ ] **CJK:** `design.md` has a CJK section and I checked the demo with Chinese text
- [ ] **Demo content is fictional:** no real people, brands, photos or logos
- [ ] I did not touch `upstream/` or other sources' templates (or I explain why below)
